title: Registry: disruption kinds
description: registry/disruptions.json in the kingdom (copied from @elvaria/registry-default on init; `elvaria migrate` copies it into a kingdom made before LL-01). Each kind of operational disruption: a time the kingdom's machinery slowed or spoiled work that was not wrong (ADR 0036). disruptionsOf reads the event log with these kinds; nothing is stored. Shapes: `event`, one event of a type meeting its conditions; `sequence`, `first` then `then` on the same values, within_seconds or after_minutes apart, unless an `unless` event comes between. Conditions: in, gte, exists on one coded field. A protected path (ADR 0026): the Monk proposes a change by letter.
$comment: Generated by `pnpm schemas` from the zod source in packages/domain/src/schema (ADR 0003): change the zod source, never this file. Not expressible here: ids are unique and every event type is in the catalog (loader, parseDisruptionKinds). Display names live here for the CLI; the UI takes them through i18n.

then.description: The first event after `first` that matches, with the same values.

same.description: Paths whose values both events have and share: `quest`, `territory`, `session`, `attempt`, or a data field such as `data.pr`.

items.description: A dotted path into the event line, from its root: `data.reason.code`, `actor.kind`, `quest`.

within_seconds.description: `then` comes at most this long after `first`; a later one matches nothing.

after_minutes.description: `then` comes at least this long after `first`: a wait, whose minutes the disruption carries.

unless.description: An event with the same values between the two means the kind does not match.
